- Use the open area in front of the bottle when approaching, leaving clearance from the red soda can behind and to the left, and avoiding brushing it with the fingers or outside of the gripper.
- Keep the bottle upright with its bottom off the table during transport. When placing, let the bottom contact and be supported by the mat steadily before releasing, reducing dragging, dropping, or tipping.
